CFML Language Reference: Functions

BitXor

Returns the bitwise exclusive OR of two integers: each bit of the result is 1 if the same bit is 1 in exactly one of the arguments.

Category

Mathematical functions

Syntax

BitXor(number1, number2)

Parameters

number1
An integer.
number2
An integer.

Returns

An integer.

Usage

XOR toggles bits: BitXor(Flags, 4) flips bit 2 on if it was off, and off if it was on. Applying the same XOR twice gives back the original number, which made it the "encryption" of choice for many a shareware program.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Secret = 1999><CFSET Key = 1234>
<CFSET Scrambled = BitXor(Secret, Key)>
<CFOUTPUT>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>Value</TH><TH>Decimal</TH><TH>Binary</TH></TR>
<TR><TD>Secret</TD><TD ALIGN="RIGHT">#Secret#</TD><TD><TT>#FormatBaseN(Secret, 2)#</TT></TD></TR>
<TR><TD>Key</TD><TD ALIGN="RIGHT">#Key#</TD><TD><TT>#FormatBaseN(Key, 2)#</TT></TD></TR>
<TR><TD>BitXor(Secret, Key)</TD><TD ALIGN="RIGHT">#Scrambled#</TD><TD><TT>#FormatBaseN(Scrambled, 2)#</TT></TD></TR>
<TR><TD>BitXor(that, Key)</TD><TD ALIGN="RIGHT">#BitXor(Scrambled, Key)#</TD><TD><TT>#FormatBaseN(BitXor(Scrambled, Key), 2)#</TT></TD></TR>
</TABLE>
</CFOUTPUT>
